summary: from_json converts a JSON string into a structured variable (wrapping json.loads), for contexts where Ansible doesn't auto-convert.
questions: How do I parse a JSON string into a variable in Ansible?
Why is my JSON output treated as a string?
Do I always need from_json for JSON output?

answer_card.title: from_json filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ json_string | from_json }}` converts a JSON string into a structured variable. It wraps Python's `json.loads`. Ansible auto-converts JSON in most contexts, so use this where it doesn't, such as command output in `stdout`.
